"#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Cantilever column linear buckling - CalculiX 2.23 input-deck generator.

Writes `model.inp` into the current working directory (the solver is NOT run;
no subprocess, no network, no external files).

Geometry : L = 200 mm along x, cross-section H = 10 mm (y) x T = 5 mm (z)
Mesh     : structured C3D20 (20-node hexahedra), 16 x 4 x 2 elements
           -> 33 x 9 x 5 = 1485 nodes
Support  : root face x = 0 fully clamped        (node set NROOT)
Load     : reference load Fx = -1 N (compression) split equally over all
           nodes of the tip face x = L          (node set NTIP);
           buckling factors multiply this reference load
Units    : mm, N, MPa, tonne/mm^3
"""

# ----------------------------------------------------------- parameters
L, H, T = 200.0, 10.0, 5.0            # mm
NE_X, NE_Y, NE_Z = 16, 4, 2           # elements (>=16 along L, >=4 H, >=2 T)
E, NU = 210000.0, 0.3                 # MPa, -
RHO = 7.85e-9                         # tonne/mm^3 (allowed, unused by *BUCKLE)
F_TOTAL = -1.0                        # N, total reference axial force
NMODES = 4                            # buckling modes requested

NX, NY, NZ = 2 * NE_X + 1, 2 * NE_Y + 1, 2 * NE_Z + 1   # nodes per direction


def nid(i, j, k):
    """Node label on the structured node grid (x fastest, then y, then z)."""
    return 1 + i + NX * (j + NY * k)


deck = []
A = deck.append

# -------------------------------------------------------------- header
A("** ==============================================================")
A("** Cantilever column - linear buckling analysis (CalculiX 2.23)")
A("** units: mm / N / MPa / tonne/mm^3")
A("** ==============================================================")

# --------------------------------------------------------------- nodes
A("*NODE, NSET=NALL")
for k in range(NZ):
    z = T * k / (2.0 * NE_Z)
    for j in range(NY):
        y = H * j / (2.0 * NE_Y)
        for i in range(NX):
            x = L * i / (2.0 * NE_X)
            A("%d, %.6f, %.6f, %.6f" % (nid(i, j, k), x, y, z))

# ------------------------------------------------------------ elements
A("*ELEMENT, TYPE=C3D20, ELSET=EALL")
eid = 0
for ek in range(NE_Z):
    K = 2 * ek
    for ej in range(NE_Y):
        J = 2 * ej
        for ei in range(NE_X):
            I = 2 * ei
            eid += 1
            # C3D20 (Abaqus/CalculiX convention):
            # 1-8 corners, 9-12 / 13-16 bottom/top face mid-sides,
            # 17-20 vertical edge mid-sides
            loc = (
                (I, J, K), (I + 2, J, K), (I + 2, J + 2, K), (I, J + 2, K),
                (I, J, K + 2), (I + 2, J, K + 2), (I + 2, J + 2, K + 2),
                (I, J + 2, K + 2),
                (I + 1, J, K), (I + 2, J + 1, K), (I + 1, J + 2, K),
                (I, J + 1, K),
                (I + 1, J, K + 2), (I + 2, J + 1, K + 2),
                (I + 1, J + 2, K + 2), (I, J + 1, K + 2),
                (I, J, K + 1), (I + 2, J, K + 1), (I + 2, J + 2, K + 1),
                (I, J + 2, K + 1),
            )
            conn = [str(nid(*p)) for p in loc]
            # at most 16 comma-separated entries per data line:
            # id + 15 nodes, then the remaining 5 nodes
            A("%d, %s" % (eid, ", ".join(conn[:15])))
            A(", ".join(conn[15:]))

# ----------------------------------------------------------- node sets
NROOT_NODES = [nid(0, j, k) for k in range(NZ) for j in range(NY)]      # x = 0
NTIP_NODES = [nid(NX - 1, j, k) for k in range(NZ) for j in range(NY)]  # x = L


def write_nset(name, nodes):
    A("*NSET, NSET=%s" % name)
    for m in range(0, len(nodes), 8):          # 8 entries per line (<= 16)
        A(", ".join(str(n) for n in nodes[m:m + 8]))


write_nset("NROOT", NROOT_NODES)   # root face x = 0 (fully clamped)
write_nset("NTIP", NTIP_NODES)     # tip face   x = L (loaded)

# ----------------------------------------------------- material & section
A("*MATERIAL, NAME=STEEL")
A("*ELASTIC, TYPE=ISO")
